info.name: BookCabin Flight Search
info.description: All request variants for /search/flight/v1 and /multi-search/flight/v1 against the provided mocks (CGK → DPS, 2025-12-15) plus the flights added to the same mock files for multi-search (DPS → CGK on 20 Dec, DPS → SUB on 18 Dec, SUB → CGK on 20 Dec). Each request has tests for its expected status and behaviour. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080) and run the collection with the server started via `make run`.

request.description: Full mock result. With retry, AirAsia's 10% simulated failure is almost always recovered; if not, metadata.providers_failed = 1 and only 9 flights return.
Run right after the previous request (cache TTL 1 minute).

item.name: Empty params are ignored (maxPrice=, maxStops=, airlines=, sortBy=)

exec: pm.test("not filtered to direct-only", () => pm.expect(body.flights.some(f => f.stops > 0)).to.be.true);

request.description: Empty query values are dropped before binding, so they behave as not provided (maxStops= would otherwise become 0 = direct only).
QZ520 departs 04:45 WIB on 15 Dec (21:45 UTC on 14 Dec); dates are matched in the departure airport's local time.
GA315 (CGK→SUB→DPS) is one CGK→DPS itinerary; its first segment is not sold as CGK→SUB.

exec: pm.test("at most 1 stop", () => body.flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.stops <= 1, f.flight_number).to.be.true));
pm.test("price in range", () => body.flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.price.amount >= 1000000 && f.price.amount <= 1500000, f.flight_number).to.be.true));
pm.test("only GA and JT", () => body.flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(["GA","JT"].includes(f.airline.code), f.flight_number).to.be.true));
pm.test("only GA and JT", () => body.flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(["GA","JT"].includes(f.airline.code), f.flight_number).to.be.true));

request.description: Single-digit hours are normalized to HH:MM before comparison.

exec: pm.test("≥ 30 seats available", () => body.flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.available_seats >= 30, f.flight_number).to.be.true));
pm.test("all filters applied", () => body.flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.stops === 0 && f.price.amount <= 1000000 && ["QZ","JT"].includes(f.airline.code), f.flight_number).to.be.true));

pm.test("cheap direct flights first, transits last", () => { const first = body.flights[0], last = body.flights[body.flights.length-1]; pm.expect(first.stops).to.eql(0); pm.expect(last.stops).to.eql(1); });

request.description: cost = 0.5·price + 0.3·duration + 0.2·stops, each min-max normalized over the filtered set; lower is better.

item.name: Tie-break: equal price keeps earlier departure first

exec: pm.test("2 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(2));
pm.test("return leg reverses the route", () => { const c = body.legs[1].search_criteria; pm.expect(c.origin).to.eql("DPS"); pm.expect(c.destination).to.eql("CGK"); });
pm.test("return leg: 5 DPS→CGK flights from the extra mocks", () => pm.expect(body.legs[1].metadata.total_results).to.eql(5));
pm.test("return flights depart DPS and arrive CGK", () => body.legs[1].flights.forEach(f => { pm.expect(f.departure.airport).to.eql("DPS"); pm.expect(f.arrival.airport).to.eql("CGK"); }));

request.description: Round-trip = two legs, the second reversing the route. Return flights (DPS→CGK on 20 Dec) were added to the mock files for multi-search.
Run right after the previous request.

exec: pm.test("3 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(3));
pm.test("DPS→SUB arrives earlier on the clock but lasts 55–60 min (WITA→WIB)", () => body.legs[1].flights.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.duration.total_minutes).to.be.within(55, 60)));

request.description: DPS→SUB (18 Dec) and SUB→CGK (20 Dec) were added to the mock files for multi-search.

exec: pm.test("2 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(2));

request.description: The next leg does not have to start where the previous one ended.

exec: pm.test("2 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(2));
pm.test("no DPS→SUB flights on 15 Dec: empty leg, not an error", () => pm.expect(body.legs[1].flights).to.eql([]));
pm.test("2 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(2));

pm.test("leg 1 direct only, sorted by price", () => { const f = body.legs[0].flights; f.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.stops).to.eql(0)); for (let i = 1; i < f.length; i++) pm.expect(f[i-1].price.amount <= f[i].price.amount).to.be.true; });
pm.test("leg 2 only GA: GA401", () => pm.expect(body.legs[1].flights.map(f => f.flight_number)).to.eql(["GA401"]));

request.description: Each leg is a normal search request, so filters and sort can differ per leg.

exec: pm.test("2 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(2));
pm.test("6 legs in request order", () => pm.expect(body.legs.length).to.eql(6));

request.description: Add the return as its own leg instead.
Multi-search is POST-only; Gin returns 404 for unregistered methods.
